requirements.statement: Deterministic Git-proof interfaces preserve Git root and baseline identity, repository-relative path normalization, worktree isolation metadata, and scoped material diff calculation.

CandidateAttestation formally binds change/work identity, candidate commit/tree, intent and material digests, EvidencePlan digest, supporting EvidenceReceipt identities/digests, available policy/runtime profile digests, and schema/version.
Sealing independently rejects stale verification, post-verification edits, changed intent, candidate content drift, and candidate ref collisions while preserving refs/keel/candidates/<change-id>.

Anchoring preserves landed ref and note semantics, rejects ref/note collisions and landed material or intent drift, and accepts candidate ancestry or content-equivalent squash/rebase with unrelated mainline changes.
Git refs and notes remain collision-checked indexes/anchors rather than the sole attestation payload or an immutability claim, and no Landing Transaction is implemented.
